label: skill-effectiveness-tracker-v1
context: Built and tested ~/subconscious/skill_effectiveness_tracker.py — a SkillEffectivenessTracker class that: (1) scans all 213 installed skills from ~/.hermes/skills/, (2) ingests skill-related experiences from the iteration engine's experiences table, (3) calculates rolling 30-day success rates, (4) flags skills below 60% success rate for archival, (5) generates comprehensive reports. Integrated into learning_bootstrap.py so it runs on session start. Currently only 1 skill has iteration engine data — the tracker will become more useful as more skill usage is recorded. Next: add observation recording to skill_view/skill_manage hooks, or enrich data from delegation_stats.
active_tasks: needs: more data sources for skill observations
